full_judgment:
5. On 14.2.83 the present petitioner, Khalilur Rahman moved this application for drawing up of proceedings of contempt of court for non-compliance of the judgments of this Court in those above Writ Petitions. In such circumstances, this present Rule for contempt of court was issued. After the Issuance of the Rule on 14.2.83 the learned Deputy Attorney General sought for time on 20.3.83 and for exemption from personal appearance of the Opposite Party Nos. 1 and 2 and the same was allowed and the case was fixed for bearing on 19th April, 1983. In the meanwhile, Martial Law Regulation No. 111 of 1983 came into being on 13th April, 1983 by the Chief Martial Law Administrator. This Regulation was made by the Chief Martial Law Administrator, in pursuance of the Proclamation of the 24th March, 1982 Articles 2 (c) and (b) of the Martial Law Regulation No. III of t 983 says that the deed of exchange dated 20.8.65 executed between Messrs. Amiya Narayan Sanayal and others of West Bengal, India and the present petitioner Md. Khalilur Rahman are declared void, fraudulent, collusive, inoperative and ineffective in spite of the judgment, decree decision writ order of the Supreme Court. The deed of settlement of lease executed by the Deputy Commissioner, Rajshahi dated 9.10.75 was also declared void and inoperative. Article 3 of this Regulation No. 111 of 1983 speaks that all judgments, decrees, decisions, writs, or orders passed or given before the commencement of this Regulation by any court including the Supreme Court in respect of this deed of exchange dated 20.8.65 and the deed of settlement dated 9.10.75 shall be void. Article 4 of this Regulation No III of 1983 reads as follows:- 

 Article 4. "All suits, appeals, petitions, applications and other legal proceedings pending, immediately before the commencement of this Regulation, in any court, including the Supreme Court, in respect of any of the scheduled properties or arising out of or in connection with any judgment, decree, decision, direction writ, order or declaration in respect of the scheduled properties shall abate forthwith and not be further proceeded with."
